title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Outreach Specialist / Appointment Setter

Schedule: Full-time (40 hs/week).

Location: Fully remote, async-first.

About This Role:

Our client is looking for a dedicated and hungry Outreach Specialist to fuel their sales pipeline. This is a junior-to-mid-level role for a \"hunter\" who thrives on chasing leads and booking qualified meetings. You will be the engine of the sales process, responsible for the initial contact that turns cold prospects into warm opportunities.

We are looking for an Operator, not just a list-builder. You must be able to execute high-volume outreach across multiple channels (Cold Call, Email, LinkedIn) and diagnose what is working to optimize your results.

Responsibilities:

  • Meeting Generation: Your primary KPI is the number of qualified meetings booked per week and per month.
  • Omnichannel Outreach: Execute campaigns using Cold Calling, Email, and LinkedIn. You have the autonomy to use the channels that yield the best results.
  • Metric Tracking: Meticulously track your daily activity (volume of outreach) and your success rates (meetings booked).
  • Pipeline Management: Ensure no lead falls through the cracks; manage follow-ups religiously until a \"No\" or a \"Yes\" is achieved.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide feedback to the strategy team on lead quality and market response to improve targeting.

Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of experience (Minimum) in outreach, appointment setting, or SDR roles.
  • Proven Track Record: Must be able to demonstrate historical success rates (specifically: Average Meetings Generated per Month) from previous roles.
  • Tool Agnostic: Experience with any standard outreach tools (e.g., Apollo, Lemlist, Sales Navigator, RingCentral) is accepted.
  • High Availability: Willingness to work 40 hours/week.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for cold calling and email copywriting.

title: Project Manager (Remote - Brazil)
description:
Project Manager — Client Delivery

Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (U.S. preferred)

Type: Full-Time

About Hitch

Hitch is a fast-growing fintech platform powering digital home equity and non-QM lending for mortgage lenders. We provide a white-label loan origination experience that helps lenders increase conversion, automate underwriting, and deliver a modern borrower experience.

We partner directly with leading lenders and embed teams within client programs to deliver high-impact product and engineering initiatives.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Project Manager to lead delivery for a strategic client engagement with one of our key lending partners. This role will be embedded in the client program and act as the bridge between Hitch's engineering team and the client's business stakeholders.

You will gather requirements, manage delivery timelines, coordinate cross-functional teams, and help shape product and workflow strategies that improve borrower conversion, underwriting efficiency, and operational performance.

This role combines project management, client engagement, and product strategy in a fast-moving fintech environment.

What You'll Do
Client & Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day delivery lead for the Deephaven project
  • Work directly with client stakeholders to understand business goals, underwriting workflows, and operational needs
  • Translate client requirements into clear product and engineering deliverables
  • Lead client meetings, status updates, and roadmap discussions
  • Manage expectations, priorities, and delivery timelines
Project & Delivery Management
  • Own project planning, execution, and delivery milestones
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, product, and QA
  • Track progress, identify risks, and remove blockers
  • Maintain project documentation, requirements, and timelines
  • Ensure high-quality releases aligned with client goals
Product Strategy & Optimization
  • Help clients improve loan conversion and underwriting outcomes
  • Recommend workflow improvements and product enhancements
  • Analyze feedback, usage patterns, and performance metrics
  • Collaborate with Hitch product leadership on roadmap decisions
  • Identify opportunities to automate processes and improve borrower experience
Requirements & Execution
  • Gather and document detailed functional and technical requirements
  • Define acceptance criteria and implementation scope
  • Work closely with engineers during development cycles
  • Support testing, validation, and production launches
What We're Looking For
Required Experience
  • 3–7+ years in project management, product operations, or client delivery roles
  • Experience working with engineering teams and technical products
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience managing complex software delivery projects
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements
  • Highly organized with strong execution and follow-through
Nice to Have
  • Mortgage, lending, fintech, or financial services experience
  • Experience with loan origination systems (Encompass or similar)
  • B2B SaaS or enterprise client delivery experience
  • Agile / Scrum experience
  • Experience with underwriting or financial workflow optimization
  • Background in product management or consulting
Success in This Role

You will succeed if you:

  • Deliver projects on time with strong client satisfaction
  • Help improve client conversion and underwriting outcomes
  • Provide clear structure and direction to engineering teams
  • Identify product improvements that create measurable business impact
  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders
Why Join Hitch
  • Work directly with major mortgage lenders shaping next-generation lending technology
  • High ownership and direct impact on product and client success
  • Fast-moving startup environment with strong growth opportunity
  • Collaborative, technical, and product-driven culture

title: Analista de Automação e Dados (RPA Python) - São Bernardo do Campo/SP
description:
Contratação PJ

Atuação híbrida - 3x presencial em São Bernardo do Campo/SP

Suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter automações (RPA) em Python para extração de dados de diversas fontes.
  • Garantir a integridade e o tratamento dos dados coletados.
  • Construir e gerenciar dashboards para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos manuais que possam ser automatizados.

O que buscamos:

  • Domínio de Python (focado em bibliotecas de automação e manipulação de dados como Pandas, Selenium, etc.).
  • Experiência na criação de dashboards (Power BI, Streamlit, Metabase ou similares).
  • Capacidade analítica para entender requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em indicadores.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Precisamos de um profissional PL auto-didata que conheça front-end e back-end, desejáveis React/Angular e Next.JS, Node.js e Python. O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma.

O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!
